blocks.tamil_translation: the one who ruins his own Hereafter is the worst of people. He is the one who, so that others may get worldly benefits, does something that displeases Allah Ta'ala and loses his own reward of the Hereafter,” Rasulullah ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اِنِّيْ اَخْوَفَ مَا اَخَافُ عَلي هذِهِ اْلاُمَّةِ مُنَافِقٌ عَلِيْمُ اللِّسَانِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “What I fear most for this Ummah is the hypocrites who are scholars only by the tongue” (one who speaks of religious knowledge without caring about his own Iman and deeds), Rasulullah ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA).

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of munafiq (hypocrite) here is one who seeks praise, or a sinner.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ قَيْسِ نِ الْخُزَاعِيِّ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ قاَمَ رِيَاءً وَسُمْعَةً لَمْ يَزَلْ فِيْ مَقْتِ اللهِ حَتَّي يَجْلِسَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever engages in a good deed with the intention that others should see it or that he should gain fame, he remains subject to the severe displeasure of Allah Ta'ala as long as he does not give up that intention,” the Prophet ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Abdullah ibn Qais Khuza'i (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبَ شُهْرَةٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا، اَلْبَسَهُ اللهُ ثَوْبَ مَذَلَّةٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ اَلْهَبَ فِيْهِ نَارًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه ، باب من لبس شهرة من الثياب، رقم:٣٦٠٧
